environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards admission controller configured in 'enforce' mode at 'restricted' profile (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-volumes' with validationFailureAction=Enforce denies any pod spec containing hostPath volume types. The container runs with securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, runAsNonRoot=true (UID 65534/nobody), readOnlyRootFilesystem=true with only /tmp and /app/data mounted as emptyDir volumes (medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 256Mi). The deployment uses a distroless base image with no shell binary available.
